items.text: A bare Node test call in a demo fails scripts/check-wrappers and the normal pre-commit path. A wrapped call passes. Keep the existing Swift and Xcode wrapper checks. Run scripts/wrap-test and scripts/check-wrappers.

The bridge error demo runs the intended listener-error assertions through the wrapper, propagates a failing result, and still finishes the normal real-bridge scenario on the assigned simulator. Run scripts/wrap-test and scripts/demo/bridge-errors.sh.
